cohort: 566 infants referred to Mashhad Ghaem Hospital clinic in Iran between 2008 and 2012
finding: Breast problems during lactation were associated with prenatal care, mode of delivery, lactation status, let-down reflex, and were linked to neonatal complications such as pathologic weight loss and decreased urination frequency.
mod_finding: Mothers who had a normal vaginal delivery had fewer breast problems compared to those who had other modes of delivery.
